# Conventions
<!-- generated by `orchestrator understand`; the PKG is source of truth, edits here are advisory -->

- start every module with `from __future__ import annotations`
- import first-party code with absolute paths under `orchestrator.` (not relative imports), kept sorted
- give every module a one-line-plus triple-quoted docstring
- fully type-annotate every function and method, including `-> None`
- keep lines within 110 characters
- write tests as module-level `def test_*` functions (not test classes)
